entities.name: Uzhhorod–Košice broad-gauge track
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Uzhhorod–Košice broad-gauge line is a single-track 1,520 mm gauge railway mostly in eastern Slovakia, which is used especially for transporting iron ore from Ukraine to the steel works near Košice.
